content.title: What does Fury have left at age 37, off 2 losses, 16-month retirement?
content.text: A note to Fight Freaks Unite readers: I created Fight Freaks Unite in January 2021 and eight months later it also became available for paid subscriptions for additional content — and as a way to help keep this newsletter going and for readers to support independent journalism. If you haven’t upgraded to a paid subscription please consider it. If you have already, I truly appreciate it! Also, consider a gift subscription for the Fight Freak in your life.Give a gift subscriptionSubscribe to the podcastSubscribe to the YouTube channelSubscribe to DAZN's Ultimate PlanLeave a commentThe singular question about former heavyweight champion Tyson Fury’s return from a 16-month retirement — which nary a soul truly believed would last — is what exactly does he have left at age 37 and coming off back-to-back grueling decision losses in championship fights to Oleksandr Usyk?We are all about to find out as the “Gypsy King” takes center stage once again when he faces Arslanbek Makhmudov, known for his big punch and soft chin, in a 12-rounder that headlines The Ring magazine card on Saturday (Netflix, 2 p.m. ET) at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium in London.Fury, who has retired and unretired at least five times, believes he has plenty left as he looks forward to a long-awaited showdown as soon as later this year against former two-time unified titleholder and British countryman Anthony Joshua.Fury watched last Saturday as his old rivals Deontay Wilder and good pal Derek Chisora — men Fury has faced three times apiece and gone 5-0-1 against — put on an exciting slugfest but showed that the wear and tear of long careers and tough fights had taken their toll.“Obviously, I’m the top man in this division and I’m gonna prove it again and again and again. And it won’t be nothing to me because it’s what I do,” the rarely modest Fury said this week. “It’s what I do. I fight, I box and after watching Derek Chisora and Deontay Wilder the other day I thought to myself I’m not gonna be like (that) on Saturday night, because if I am please take me out to the field and shoot me. Definitely.Give a gift subscription
